says: After build.ts replaces <home>/build by rename, the running stage serves that build once and then no longer sees later changes to the folder
proof: review probe on a temp home: append before the swap re-served with a new pid; append after the swap gave no Rebuilding line and the same pid; not tried on the unpatched watcher
cost: a second rebuild into a running stage is silently ignored until a restart

says: Today's lead tooling: leakgrep.sh was changed again (ticket 548) and is still a shell script with Python inside, where decision 0033 says a shell or Python script moves to TypeScript and Effect when it is next touched.
proof: head -1 .agents/skills/lead/scripts/leakgrep.sh prints '#!/bin/sh', and git log --oneline -3 on that file shows the changes of tickets 500, 532 and 548, each after 0033's date (2026-11-09). .decisions/0033-agents-code-follows-next-rules.md: 'Shell and Python move to TypeScript and Effect when next touched, one script at a time'.
cost: The check's rules stay in a language pnpm lint and pnpm typecheck do not read, and each change to it adds to a move that five test files (57 laws, run against the script by path) must follow.
